monte_carlo_error.note: Simulated joint probability minus the analytic product of leg probabilities. Small values confirm the simulation reproduces the independence structure it is given.

predicted_vs_realized.note: realized_roi is the mean return per unit staked on the top-ranked parlays. A large positive mean_predicted_ev beside a negative realized_roi is the signature of an edge that was noise.

within_card_residual_correlation.note: Pearson correlation between pairs of same-card residuals. Near zero supports treating fights on a card as conditionally independent given features, which is what the parlay joint probability assumes.
